title: Canonical ordinary and derived open scalar comparison data
statement: Let $A,B$ be commutative rings, $\varphi:A\to B$ a ring homomorphism, and $j:U\hookrightarrow Y$ an open immersion of schemes. Use small etale module derived categories [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories], open extension by zero [def-weil-pbc-extension-by-zero] and exact inverse image [prop-weil-pbc-inverse-image-modules-exact]. Write $J_A=j_A^*$ and $K_A=j_{!,A}$, with their specified ordinary and degreewise derived adjunctions [lem-weil-pbc-extension-by-zero-adjunction], and similarly for $B$. Define derivedRestriction and derivedExtension as the exact degreewise derived functors of $J_A$ and $K_A$. Let $E_T$ be ordinary scalar extension with its specified adjunction [def-sf-etale-sheaf-scalar-extension], $R_T$ ordinary restriction of scalars, $T_T$ the fixed derived scalar left adjoint [def-weil-pbc-witness-compatibility], and $DR_T$ its exact derived right adjoint. Define openRestrictScalarsIso $J_B R_U\cong R_Y J_A$ by transporting the sectionwise identity through the canonical open restriction identification. Define openScalarRestrictionZero $J_A E_U\cong E_Y J_B$ by uniqueness of left adjoints to the common composite scalar-restriction/direct-image right adjoint. Define openScalarExtensionZero $K_A E_Y\cong E_U K_B$ by uniqueness of composite left adjoints, using openRestrictScalarsIso on their right adjoints. Define openDerivedRestrictScalarsIso $DJ_B DR_U\cong DR_Y DJ_A$ by exact derived descent of openRestrictScalarsIso. Define openScalarExtension $DK_A T_Y\cong T_U DK_B$ by uniqueness of composite scalar/open derived left adjoints using openDerivedRestrictScalarsIso. Finally, define openScalarRestrictionMap $DJ_A T_U\to T_Y DJ_B$ as the inverse scalar-adjunction mate of the inverse of openDerivedRestrictScalarsIso. Here adjacent functors are composed from left to right. These definitions use the actual specified adjunctions; the last map is defined without any assertion of its invertibility.

def openScalarRestrictionMap {A B : Type (u + 1)} [CommRing A] [CommRing B]
    (φ : A →+* B) {U X : Scheme.{u}} (j : U ⟶ X) [IsOpenImmersion j] :
    derivedRestriction (A := A) j ⋙ scalarExtension φ U ⟶
      scalarExtension φ X ⋙ derivedRestriction (A := B) j
